title: 第21章 八管珊瑚第22章 训练计划
lines: 第21章八管珊瑚
“呵，我到站了，懒得跟你们掰扯。”国字脸男人说完转身就准备下车。
站在他右侧的青年手里提着一个塑料袋。
国字脸男人推开青年匆忙朝车后门走去。
乔桑发现他的手碰向的是青年的肩膀，身体没有触碰到其它的地方，可是那塑料袋却发出窸窸窣窣的声响。
“火牙狗，朝他的腰使用火。”乔桑直接命令道。
火牙狗全身处于一种一触即发的状态。
它看眼前这个人类很不爽了，要不是自家御兽师用手按着它不让动，它早就把自己的十八般武艺使在他身上。
现下有了命令，卯足了劲地将体内的能量聚集起来喷射出去。
平时只有婴儿拳头大小的火此刻足有成年人的手掌那么大。
一道尖利的惨叫声响彻整辆公交车。
公交车上的人都吓了一跳，前车门刚步子迈上来的乘客更是吓得倒退回了站台。
“师傅，关门！”乔桑转头对司机喊道。
司机从后视镜里看到车内的情景，愣了半晌。
只见一只两米多长着八根触须的白色水螅体凭空出现在公交车内，随着它的出现八根触须劈哩叭啦掉出一大堆东西。
“师傅，关门！”乔桑见司机没动静，不得不又提醒道。
“哦哦。”司机反应过来，手忙脚乱地按了开关按钮。
见司机关了门，乔桑注意力又集中到了眼前。
这是个啥？
虽然这段时间有狠狠恶补知识，但学渣还是学渣，乔桑认不出眼前的超凡生物是什么。
乔桑转过头向女学生问道：“这是什么？”
“是我的手机！”
“还有我的！”
“我的沙沙果！”
“我给我女朋友买的项链也在！”
“我的增高鞋垫！！！”
公交车上的人一个个激动地认领着自己的东西。
国字脸男人面色阴沉地看着眼前的一切。
一切发生的太突然，他的八管珊瑚受伤让他没有在第一时间下车，现在车门也关了，赃物也都掉了出来。
都怪这个女的！
国字脸男人怨毒地看向有着火牙狗的少女。
要不是这只火牙狗跟这个女的，他这次怎么会失手！
现在一切都迟了，一车子的人盯着他，他要是逃，就必须得破坏公交车，肯定会让车上的人受伤。
偷窃跟袭击市民这两个罪名的区别他还是知道的，前者顶多罚点钱关个一两个月，后者则是判几年到几十年不等。
他现在只能安静呆着，等着警察局的人来抓他。
乔桑见国字脸男人表情颓然下来，将她那还不知道叫什么名字的超凡生物收了起来，一副束手就擒的样子。
“大家快按住他别让他逃了！”乔桑喊道。
她一拳头挥了过去，国字脸男人下意识往后退了两步，大家见状以为他要逃跑，状蜂拥而上将他按倒在地。
不知道是谁先说了一句：“你还敢打人？！”
大家一听顿时怒了，偷了东西被发现还敢这么嚣张？
瞬间拳打脚踢招呼了过去。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Eight Tubes of Coral
"Oh, I'm at the station and I'm too lazy to talk to you." After saying this, the man with the Chinese character turned around and prepared to get off the car.
The young man standing to his right was holding a plastic bag.
The man with a Chinese character pushed the young man aside and hurried towards the back door of the car.
Qiao Sang found that his hand touched the young man's shoulder and his body did not touch other parts, but the plastic bag made a rustling sound.
"Fire Tooth Dog, use fire on his waist." Qiao Sang ordered directly.
The Fire Tooth Dog's whole body was in a state of being on the verge of breaking out.
It was very unhappy with the human in front of it. If its own beastmaster hadn't held it down with his hands to prevent it from moving, it would have used all of its eighteen martial arts on him.
Now that he had the order, he gathered all the energy in his body and sprayed it out.
Huo, who was usually the size of a baby's fist, was now as big as an adult's hand.
"Whatever!!!"
A sharp scream echoed throughout the bus.
Everyone on the bus was startled, and the passengers who had just stepped forward from the front door were even more frightened and fell back to the platform.
"Master, close the door!" Qiao Sang turned to the driver and shouted.
The driver saw the scene inside the car in the rearview mirror and was stunned for a long time.
A two-meter-long white polyp with eight tentacles appeared out of thin air in the bus. As it appeared, the eight tentacles crackled and a lot of things fell out.
"Master, close the door!" Qiao Sang had to remind him again when he saw that the driver didn't move.
"Oh." The driver reacted and pressed the switch button hurriedly.
Seeing the driver closing the door, Qiao Sang focused his attention on his eyes again.
What is this?
Although he diligently supplemented his knowledge during this period, he was still a scumbag. Qiao Sang could not recognize the extraordinary creature in front of him.
Qiao Sang turned to the female student and asked, "What is this?"
"It's my cell phone!"
Qiao Sang: "..."
"And mine!"
"My Shashaguo!"
"The necklace I bought for my girlfriend is here too!"
“My height increasing insoles!!!”
Everyone on the bus excitedly claimed their belongings.
The man with the Chinese character face looked at everything in front of him with a gloomy expression.
Everything happened so suddenly. His eight-tube coral was injured and he didn't get out of the car at the first time. Now the car door is closed and the stolen goods have fallen out.
It's all this woman's fault!
The man with the Chinese character looked at the girl with the fire-toothed dog bitterly.
If it weren't for this fire-toothed dog and this woman, how could he have missed this time!
It was too late now. A bus of people was staring at him. If he escaped, he would have to destroy the bus, which would definitely injure the people on the bus.
He still knew the difference between the two charges of stealing and assaulting a citizen. The former could only be fined for a month or two, while the latter could be sentenced to several years to decades.
Now he can only stay quietly and wait for people from the police station to catch him.
Qiao Sang saw that the man with the Chinese character's face became slumped, and put away her extraordinary creature whose name she still didn't know, as if she was ready to capture it.
"Everyone, hold him down quickly and don't let him escape!" Qiao Sang shouted.
She waved her fist, and the man with the Chinese character took two steps back subconsciously. Seeing this, everyone thought he was going to run away, so they swarmed up and pushed him to the ground.
I don’t know who said it first: “How dare you hit someone?!”
Everyone immediately became angry when they heard this. How dare you be so arrogant when you were caught stealing something?
He was greeted with punches and kicks in an instant.
